scope: Corollary 10.1 (Complex-projective type) of the manuscript “The metric Blaschke theorem” (preprints/The-metric-Blaschke-theorem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 344 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c631e2d36940a81e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: A Blaschke manifold of complex-projective type is isometric to its equally scaled standard complex projective model.
